title: Audit and enforce shared package evaluator boundary invariants
outcome: Audit and enforce shared package evaluator boundary invariants
acceptance: Audit ownership of compile versus restore projection, diagnostic precedence, positional helper versus final-property expansion, and normalization across repeated expansion calls; distinguish current guarantees from reproduced defects and dormant hazards.

Propose a bounded design that makes positional callbacks and normalized package identities explicit at the shared evaluator boundary, linking existing follow-ups without duplicating them; obtain an independent design opinion before implementation.
